case_title: State of M.P. v. Ashok & Others Etc.
offence_finally_established: Murder under IPC s.302 read with s.149
neutral_facts: The victim was returning home on a bicycle when he was stopped by an individual who poured petrol over him and set him on fire. The victim ran away but was surrounded by several individuals who encouraged others to beat and burn him. The victim was unable to escape and was eventually found burned and injured. A witness who was present at the scene reported that the victim was set on fire and that others were involved in surrounding him and encouraging the attack. The post-mortem report confirmed severe burns and an incised wound on the victim's back, supporting the account of the witness. The prosecution relied on the witness's testimony and the post-mortem findings to establish the involvement of the accused in the attack.
